notes: Labeled trigger fixtures for develop-like-sudipta. Positives span the 11 engineering pillars (preservation, plan-first, code-quality, env-sync, security, TDD, resilience, API design, git discipline, clean codebase, dep selection, CI/CD). Negatives are realistic non-engineering asks plus a few superficially-technical but off-pillar prompts.
